area: Leamouth: Orchard Place, Salter's Buildings, West and Duke Streets, Lea Passage, Mission Hall, Orchard House, Bond's Wharf, Old Orchard Yard, Orchard House Yard; River Lea / Bow Creek mouth; Thames Iron Works yard east of the creek
method: Overview at 1x; 9 sweep crops r0c0..r2c2 at 2x, each anchored on opening (r0c0 ORCHARD PLACE/SALTER'S BUILDINGS/Oil Mills; r0c1 RIVER/High Water Mark of Ordinary Tides; r0c2 Crane/Centre of Channel; r1c0 Mission Hall/LEA PASSAGE/Orchard House; r1c1 Cranes/M.P.; r1c2 Thame(s) lettering; r2c0 Warehouses/Bond's Wharf/Old Orchard Yard; r2c1 BOW/Orchard House Yard/Causeway; r2c2 BOW CREEK/Slips/Leamouth Wharf). Contact sheets cs1-cs2 at 6x +/-22 px, z1-z2 at 12x +/-13 px, z1b 16x nearest, z3 and z5 at 20x (5/6/8 checks), z4 at 14x (pheons), w1 at 5x +/-32 px; numeric dot-centroid helper and pixel tables; marker sheets mk0-mk1 at 6x viewed before writing. Every crop and sheet displayed when opened and has an anchor in my notes. Not read from other readers' files.
legibility: Clear but faint in places; vertical sheet join px ~345 (full height; tool reports ~340) and horizontal join py ~393 (tool ~390); no figure crosses either. No missing tiles; the grey strip below py ~1022 in zooms is crop padding past the edge. The Thames Iron Works yard and the Bow Creek wharves carry no height figures on this mosaic; M.P. (mooring posts), Cranes, x' channel-line marks are not heights.
